.github/.command: rtk scripts/ci-local.sh doctor && rtk env REDLINE_STRICT_TOOLS=1 bash ops/ci/security.sh
.github/.purpose: verify GitHub workflows delegate to blocking local lanes and pass workflow security lint

.gitlab-ci.yml.purpose: verify the retired GitLab pipeline remains absent after the GitHub cutover

.jankurai/.purpose: verify mirrored control-plane proof routing remains consistent

.jeryu/.purpose: verify local-Jeryu policy changes retain the canonical CI entrypoints

.gitignore.purpose: verify ignored CI and release outputs remain bounded

AGENTS.md.purpose: verify agent-routing changes retain the Rust proof surface

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: verify release notes remain aligned with release readiness

README.md.purpose: verify public release and proof documentation remains complete

agent/.purpose: verify mirrored control-plane proof routing remains consistent

build.rs.purpose: verify embedded corpus generation remains build-addressable

corpus/beyond_sqlite/.purpose: verify every beyond-SQLite case passes psql↔psql self-compare before shipping

corpus/sqlite_parity/cases/.purpose: verify every SQLite-parity case passes sqlite3↔sqlite3 self-compare before shipping

corpus/sqlite_parity/generated_manifest..purpose: verify the embedded pinned SQLite parity manifest parses and matches expected counts

corpus/sqlite_parity/rules/.purpose: verify generated shards match their rule files

deny.toml.purpose: verify Rust dependency policy remains fail closed

docs/.purpose: verify release, rollback, monitoring, and proof documentation

gitleaks.toml.purpose: verify secret scanning remains fail closed

justfile.purpose: verify the local release tarball and checksum

metadata/.purpose: verify the packaged beyond-SQLite metadata parses

ops/.purpose: verify required, security, and release evidence lanes

rust-toolchain.toml.purpose: verify the pinned Rust toolchain builds the locked graph

schemas/.purpose: verify packaged JSON contracts and release hashes

scripts/.purpose: verify local CI and release scripts remain executable

src/.purpose: verify the runner logic and CLI contract

templates/.purpose: verify report templates remain packaged and hashed

tests/.purpose: verify Rust integration tests for parity, release integrity, timing, and CI contracts

xtask/.purpose: verify the corpus generator builds and produces drift-free shards
